description.value: A prospective population-based neuroimaging study investigating associations between prenatal cannabis and tobacco exposure and brain morphology in 6- to 8-year-old children using structural MRI and vertexwise cortical thickness analyses.

spans.text: The aim of this study was to investigate the association between prenatal cannabis exposure and brain morphology in childhood.

value: Our hypothesis is that prenatal cannabis exposure will be associated with global morphological differences in the offspring brain, similar or even increased as compared with the association between prenatal tobacco exposure and brain morphology.

spans.text: Our hypothesis is that prenatal cannabis exposure will be associated with global morphological differences in the offspring brain, similar or even increased as compared with the association between prenatal tobacco exposure and brain morphology.

description.value: Population-based prospective cohort study of children from the Generation R Study, with prenatal exposure groups compared using structural MRI at ages 6 to 8 years.
